Menu

What visitors mention

Dishes named in public listings. No prices shown; this is not a verified menu. Photos are illustrative stock images.

  • 3 Quesabirrias

    Shredded beef tacos with melted cheese and birria sauce for dipping, topped with onion and cilantro, with lime.

  • Street Taco

    One street taco with your choice of meat, topped with onion and cilantro, with a side of limes.

  • Burrito

    12-inch flour tortilla with black beans, rice, avocado, lettuce and pico de gallo; your choice of meat.

  • Quesadillas

    Double 8-inch soft flour tortilla with melted cheese; choice of one meat.

  • Torta

    Mexican sandwich with melted cheese, refried beans, lettuce, avocado and pico de gallo; choice of meat.

  • 3 Sopes

    Fried corn tortilla with refried beans, lettuce, pico de gallo, avocado and queso fresco; choice of meat.

  • Tamales

    Traditional tamales — named among the most-ordered items in public listings.

  • Carne Asada Plate

    Red rice, refried beans, salad and avocado, a slice of carne asada, and a soft homemade tortilla.

The concept

A full page, built around the favourites

This demo turns the dishes visitors name in public listings into a complete visit — menu, gallery, and directions in one place.

The menu above lists visitor-reported favourites, not a verified menu, and every photo on this page is illustrative stock — not photography of this business. What this concept adds is structure: the favourites up front, the visit details in one place, and a clear next step at the bottom.

Sabor De Casa started in Beaufort in 2022 and now runs two trucks in town — one at the Food Truck Court on Parris Island Gateway, the other at Caliber Collision on Boundary Street. If anything here looks out of date, the fastest check is a phone call — hours, availability, and the day's specials are best confirmed directly.
